Build a Submission Profile from Caller-Supplied Values

Source: R/custom_profile.R
custom_profile.Rd

Constructs a submission_profile from values you supply, rather than from a built-in regulatory authority. Every regulatory quantity (pillar weights, decision bands, required indicators and asset types, minimum coverage, RPN bands, detectability) is a required argument with no default: this function invents no weights or thresholds of its own. It is the escape hatch for a sponsor who must score against an internal, regional, or not-yet-shipped ruleset whose numbers come from their own authoritative source.

Usage

custom_profile(
  authority,
  submission_type,
  pillar_weights,
  bands,
  required_indicators,
  required_asset_types,
  minimum_coverage,
  rpn_bands,
  default_detectability,
  full_name = authority,
  country = NA_character_,
  study_phase = NULL
)

Arguments

authority

Character. A name for the authority or ruleset (used in printed output; it need not be one of the built-in authorities).

submission_type

Character. A name for the submission type.

pillar_weights

Named numeric vector with names "quality", "trace", "risk", and "usability" (in any order), each in [0, 1] and summing to 1.

bands

Named list of decision bands with names "ready", "minor_gaps", "conditional", and "high_risk", each a length-2 numeric c(low, high). The bands must be integer-contiguous and together cover 0-100.

required_indicators

Non-empty character vector of required indicator_id values (no NA, no duplicates).

required_asset_types

Non-empty character vector of required asset types (no NA, no duplicates).

minimum_coverage

Single numeric in [0, 1]: the fraction of required indicators that must be present.

rpn_bands

Named list of RPN bands with names "critical", "high", "medium", and "low", each a length-2 numeric c(low, high). The bands must be integer-contiguous and together cover 1-125.

default_detectability

Single whole number in 1:5.

full_name

Character. Full name of the authority. Defaults to authority.

country

Character or NA. Country or region. Defaults to NA.

study_phase

Character or NULL. Optional study phase, stored as-is.

Value

A list of class "submission_profile", identical in shape to the output of submission_profile().

Details

The supplied structure is validated the same way the shipped profiles are: pillar weights must sum to 1, decision bands must be integer-contiguous and cover 0-100, and RPN bands must be integer-contiguous and cover 1-125. The result is an ordinary submission_profile, so every function in this package that takes one – profile_summary(), validate_against_profile(), profile_sci_config(), profile_risk_config(), profile_required_indicators() – works on it unchanged.

See also

submission_profile() for the built-in authorities.

Examples

prof <- custom_profile(
  authority = "Internal",
  submission_type = "Gate2",
  pillar_weights = c(quality = 0.4, trace = 0.2, risk = 0.3, usability = 0.1),
  bands = list(
    ready = c(85, 100), minor_gaps = c(70, 84),
    conditional = c(50, 69), high_risk = c(0, 49)
  ),
  required_indicators = c("Q-MISS-VAR", "T-TRACE-LEVEL", "R-HIGH-RPN"),
  required_asset_types = c("dataset", "define"),
  minimum_coverage = 0.8,
  rpn_bands = list(
    critical = c(80, 125), high = c(40, 79),
    medium = c(15, 39), low = c(1, 14)
  ),
  default_detectability = 3L
)
profile_summary(prof)
#> ℹ Submission Profile: Internal Gate2
#>   Authority:    Internal (NA)
#> 
#>   Pillar Weights:
#>     quality     0.40
#>     trace       0.20
#>     risk        0.30
#>     usability   0.10
#> 
#>   Decision Bands:
#>     ready         [85, 100]
#>     minor_gaps    [70, 84]
#>     conditional   [50, 69]
#>     high_risk     [0, 49]
#> 
#>   Required Indicators (3):
#>     - Q-MISS-VAR
#>     - T-TRACE-LEVEL
#>     - R-HIGH-RPN
#> 
#>   Required Asset Types: dataset, define
#>   Minimum Coverage:     80%
#>   Default Detectability: 3
